Connect GitHub to run the scraper

This triggers the same scrape workflow shown in the repo’s Actions tab, straight from your browser. It needs a GitHub token — stored only in this browser’s local storage, never sent anywhere but GitHub’s own API. Only someone with write access to the repo can actually make it run, so this is safe to leave on a public page.

  1. Open github.com/settings/personal-access-tokens/new
  2. Under “Repository access”, choose Only select repositories → lego-intelligence-agent
  3. Under “Permissions” → “Repository permissions”, set Actions to Read and write
  4. Generate the token, then paste it below
